name: Bloxblast
description:
BloxBlast SMP Your Survival Adventure

Welcome to BloxBlast SMP, a Minecraft survival server where you can explore, build, gather resources, and create your own adventure.

Server IP play.bloxblast.net

Game Mode SMP Survival

Explore the world, collect resources, and survive.

Build your own base and create amazing structures.

Play together with other players and become part of a friendly community.

Edition Java and Bedrock if supported.

Whether you enjoy building, exploring, or surviving in Minecraft, BloxBlast SMP is the perfect place to start your journey.

Join BloxBlast SMP today and make your survival adventure unforgettable.
